concise_definition: Stable angina is a clinically distinct cardiology entity: Myocardial oxygen supply-demand mismatch or acute coronary obstruction produces ischemia.
time_course: acute when symptoms evolve over minutes to days; chronic phenotypes require longitudinal assessment
severity_or_acuity: emergent when perfusion, oxygenation, or electrical stability is threatened
epidemiology_summary: Atherosclerotic risk, diabetes, smoking, hypertension, and dyslipidemia are common risks.
risk_factors_summary: Atherosclerotic risk, diabetes, smoking, hypertension, and dyslipidemia are common risks.
pathophysiology_summary: Myocardial oxygen supply-demand mismatch or acute coronary obstruction produces ischemia.
